ownerRequest: Merge duplicate Explore places; where a record is really a duplicate, clean it up and remove it (owner, 24 Oct 2026).
method: Every pair was read from the live public APIs on 24 Oct 2026 (/api/catalogue, /api/menus, /api/place-reviews/summaries, /api/reactions/place). Both records share the map point to five decimals and the postcode; every pair has zero reviews, likes and shares on both ids, so no member data moves. The kept record is the packaged one: it has at least as many dishes, the venue's own cover where the duplicate has an illustration, and the original research sources. The duplicate is hidden (reversible in Admin > Content > Places), never deleted.
